description: Strategy catalog for the NFL Lines & Strategy hub. Strategies are frameworks that must pass validation gates before they are eligible for the leaderboard. No performance results are reported until a strategy passes validation; those fields are intentionally blank and flagged.

strategies.name: Single-bet signal: model edge on side / total
strategies.description: Originates a model-implied probability for a single point-spread, total (or moneyline) selection and takes the selection only when the model edge versus the market exceeds a threshold. Selective by design: it passes only when the edge and confidence are both sufficient.
strategies.correlationMethod: Not applicable for a single leg; independence assumption checked against same-game overlap.
strategies.skillVsLuck: Edge vs market / closing-line value, selectivity-weighted; ranked only after gates pass.

strategies.name: Single-bet signal: home/road situational model
strategies.description: Situational single-bet model combining venue, rest, division and schedule context with model-implied probabilities, restricted to a curated set of high-confidence situations to keep it selectively skill-based.
strategies.correlationMethod: Not applicable for a single leg.
strategies.skillVsLuck: Edge vs market / closing-line value, selectivity-weighted; ranked only after gates pass.

strategies.name: Parlay signal: uncorrelated multi-game combination
strategies.description: Combines single-bet selections from unrelated games into a parlay only when each leg independently clears the edge threshold and the estimated cross-leg correlation is low, so the combined probability is not overstated.
strategies.correlationMethod: Cross-leg correlation estimated from play-level data (SU4); combined probability recomputed with the correlation matrix rather than assuming independence.
strategies.skillVsLuck: Correlation-adjusted edge vs market; ranked only after gates pass.

strategies.name: Parlay signal: same-game correlated combination
strategies.description: Same-game parlay that explicitly models the positive correlation between legs (e.g. passing yards and team total) so the true probability reflects dependence; only used where correlation is measured, not assumed.
strategies.correlationMethod: Same-game correlation estimated from play-level data (SU4); dependence modelled explicitly.
strategies.skillVsLuck: Correlation-adjusted edge vs market; ranked only after gates pass.

strategies.name: Player-prop combo: pass-game volume stack
strategies.description: Player-prop combination keyed on pass-game volume and target share, with a starter/backup check to confirm the targeted receiver/quarterback is the starting player and not a backup, reducing no-action risk.
validationGates: Named player confirmed as starter (not backup)
strategies.correlationMethod: Correlation between the combined player props estimated from play-level data (SU4).
strategies.skillVsLuck: Edge vs market / closing-line value, selectivity-weighted; ranked only after gates pass.

strategies.name: Player-prop combo: defensive pressure + pass-rush prop
strategies.description: Player-prop combination linking defensive pressure/pass-rush outcomes, with a defense depth check to confirm the targeted rusher is a starter and that backup usage is not degrading the signal.
validationGates: Named player confirmed as starter (not backup)
strategies.correlationMethod: Correlation between the combined defensive props estimated from play-level data (SU4).
strategies.skillVsLuck: Edge vs market / closing-line value, selectivity-weighted; ranked only after gates pass.
